title: Original Oven Roasted Kenyan Green Beans Stew
description: A salty, chewy, and energizing Kenyan dish featuring green beans and rest-meat, served in a lazy-susan-spinner vessel. This shojin-friendly stew is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the green beans with 1 tablespoon of oil and season with salt and pepper.
Spread the green beans on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
In a large pot, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat and saute the onion, garlic, and ginger until softened.
Add the rest-meat to the pot and cook until browned.
Add the tomato paste, vegetable broth, salt, and pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the roasted green beans to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot in a lazy-susan-spinner vessel.
